ValidationRule.description: Termination date requires it to be after hire, salary freezes after termination and review timestamps cannot go back in time.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Termination_Date__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Hire_Date__c)), Termination_Date__c < Hire_Date__c), AND(NOT(ISNEW()), NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Termination_Date__c))), ISCHANGED(Salary__c)), AND(NOT(ISNEW()), ISCHANGED(Last_Review_At__c), NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Last_Review_At__c))), Last_Review_At__c < PRIORVALUE(Last_Review_At__c)), AND(NOT(ISNEW()), ISCHANGED(Hire_Date__c), ISPICKVAL(Employment_Type__c, 'Full Time'), Hire_Date__c < TODAY() - 365) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Termination, salary freeze or review timestamp rules violated.
